title: VUA BDL warehouse command v0.2
description: Write commands over the local BDL warehouse (docs/protocols/bdl-commands-v0.2): the B4 artifact-mode trio plus the U8-ruled global-default write (warehouse.setGlobalDefaultMode). setArtifactMode sets or clears the per-entry artifact-mode override (null clears; resolution stays dynamic: override ?? global default). generateVpm and deleteOriginals submit audited maintenance tasks and return a task acceptance; their completion payloads travel the application-contract task surface, not this schema. setGlobalDefaultMode persists the two-level options' global level into BDL (bdl_meta), superseding the provider's environment-injected initial default from the moment of the write; it is synchronous and never touches entry overrides. The transport envelope (requestId, commandId, correlationId, taskId semantics) belongs to the application contract — this schema freezes the operation closed set and the params. Guards are server-side facts, never client assertions: generateVpm runs only in the generate_vpm effective mode with original material and no existing artifact; deleteOriginals only in the generate_vpm effective mode with a verified generated artifact.

mode.description: The persisted global default. Unlike the entry-level override there is no null: the global default always has a value (the provider's environment-injected initial default until the first write).
